title: screenshotstatus
summary: PrintScreen is a normal bindable in-world command with the reference default, plus the reference's separate hard-coded physical PrintScreen edge on login, connecting, character-select, and character-create glue screens. Both routes hide any previous status before arming the shutter, capture the final framebuffer after ImGui and the top overlay, write a uniquely suffixed WoWScrnShot_MMDDYY_HHMMSS PNG under the workspace Screenshots folder, and only then announce byte-exact success/failure text at the rule-owned full-display center. ScreenshotStatusUiLaw owns the measured text minimum as well as the center seat; the renderer contains no local Vector2 geometry. The SystemFont line fades linearly over the reference 1.5 seconds, so a rapid second capture cannot photograph the first result. Focused and full deterministic checks pass.

openItems.text: The in-world bindable PrintScreen path is implemented. Glue/login/character-select screens still do not provide the reference's separate hard-coded unrebindable screenshot handler.
openItems.resolution: UpdateGlueScreenshotInput owns a separate unrebindable physical PrintScreen edge before every pre-world early return. Login, connecting, character-select, and character-create paths all draw the same rule-owned centered status overlay and use the proven hide-before-final-frame capture transaction; gameplay continues to use the independently rebindable SCREENSHOT command.

openItems.text: Live-verify ordinary and rapid double PrintScreen captures in-world and on login, connecting, character-select, and character-create screens: final framebuffer contents, absence of the prior status line from the second PNG, success/failure text, exact center seat and 1.5-second alpha fade, unique same-second suffixes, hard-coded glue behavior, and custom in-world rebinding.
